set hostname cp-gw1
set interface eth0 ipv4-address 192.0.2.2 mask-length 28
set interface eth0 comments "External"
set interface eth0 state on
set interface eth1 ipv4-address 10.100.0.1 mask-length 16
set interface eth1 state on
add interface eth1 vlan 400
set interface eth1.400 ipv4-address 172.31.40.1 mask-length 24
set interface eth1.400 state on
add bonding group 2
set bonding group 2 interface eth2
set bonding group 2 interface eth3
set static-route default nexthop gateway address 192.0.2.1 on
set static-route 10.200.0.0/16 nexthop gateway address 10.100.0.254 on
set ntp server primary 10.100.9.9
set cluster member on
